review_description: There were several delays, where the original inverter was found to be faulty, and had to be replaced. A couple of times, I got a late notice that they could not be here on the day they had indicated a technician would arrive. Apart from the delays and the inverter replacement, the physical installation of both the panels and the battery was fine; they were careful of the tiles, and replaced several that had cracked, and they tidied up after their work. The inspection has occurred, and the system is working.

Bought a Reclaim system. The guys know the products well. The installer came the same day because we had no hot water. Professional installation and took away the old hot water system and rubbish. A1 experience no complaints.
